note: Studio sets. The backdrop fills the whole background and sweeps seamlessly into the floor, so the below view (35 degrees up) must still show only backdrop: no top edge, ceiling, lights, stands or cables. Variants change colour or light, never add equipment (docs/scene/PLAN.md §3).

forms.desc: a large photographic studio white cyclorama, a smooth matte white curved wall that sweeps seamlessly into a matte white floor with no visible corner or seam, the white surface filling the whole background and both edges of the frame, the floor-to-wall curve forming a soft gradient band far behind the standing spot, nothing else in frame, and a clear patch of plain white floor in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
forms.keep: matte white curved cyclorama filling the whole background and both edges, seamless sweep from wall into floor, no seams, no top edge, no lights or equipment, empty white floor in the centre
checks: 白色背景占满整个画面、看不到边缘

variants.light: Bright even high-key studio light, the white backdrop clean and nearly shadowless, a very faint soft shadow area on the floor at the centre, not blown out

forms.desc: a photographic studio set of a wide roll of {colour} seamless backdrop paper hanging from far above the frame and sweeping in a smooth curve onto the floor toward the camera, the {colour} paper filling the whole background and both edges of the frame with a uniform matte surface, no creases or tears, the same paper continuing under the standing spot, nothing else in frame, and a clear patch of plain {colour} paper floor in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
